body:
@zhuazhua-fox 谢谢 / thank you — useful research.

EN: We checked your six sources. SEP-414 is real and Final, but it was created in April 2025 and documents an existing convention (traceparent/tracestate/baggage in _meta); it is not new in the 2026-07-28 release. traceAI-mcp is real. We could not find arXiv 2603.13417: can you send the exact title or link?
What we did with it: our free verifier now also checks whether an MCP server accepts W3C trace context (SEP-414) and returns trace headers. Informational only, it never makes a verdict worse.
Your observability.jsonl is a good idea: add a timestamp, a run id and the exit reason to each line, then the last line tells you when and why it stopped.

中文：我们核对了你的六个来源。SEP-414 是真的，已定稿，但它创建于2025年4月，记录的是已有的约定（_meta里的traceparent/tracestate/baggage），并不是2026-07-28版本才新增的。traceAI-mcp 也是真的。arXiv 2603.13417 我们没找到：能发一下准确的标题或链接吗？
我们的做法：免费验证工具现在也会检查MCP server是否接受W3C trace context（SEP-414）并返回trace头。仅供参考，不会让结论变差。
你的observability.jsonl很好：每行加上时间戳、run id和退出原因，最后一行就能告诉你它何时、为何停止。
